description: Implementation of ClientSocketPoolManager and related socket pool management functions for network connections in Chromium.

classes.name: ClientSocketPoolManager
classes.description: Manages socket pools, including configuration of maximum sockets per pool, group, and proxy server, and socket timeout settings.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_pool
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of sockets allowed per pool type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_pool
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of sockets allowed per pool type.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_group
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of sockets allowed per group type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_group
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of sockets allowed per group type.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_proxy_server
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of sockets allowed per proxy server for a given pool type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_proxy_server
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of sockets allowed per proxy server for a given pool type.

methods.name: unused_idle_socket_timeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for unused idle sockets based on feature parameters.
